2026_02_DET_BUF.headline: Short-week pressure rises as Detroit visits Buffalo’s new home
2026_02_DET_BUF.paragraph1: Detroit and Buffalo both enter Thursday night unbeaten, but the short turnaround puts preparation and line health under an immediate microscope. The Lions’ own update lists multiple offensive linemen managing injuries after their overtime opener, while Buffalo’s Week 2 preview emphasizes the challenge of a short week before the first regular-season game at the new Highmark Stadium. Detroit needs enough protection to let Jared Goff operate cleanly; Buffalo wants Josh Allen and its defense to keep the Lions chasing the pace.
2026_02_DET_BUF.model_rationale: Detroit’s protection on a short week determines whether the Lions can sustain their offense or Buffalo can create the disruptive possessions that tilt the game toward Josh Allen.
